title: Community service
subtitle: 「社區服務／義務服務／為社群服務」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「社區服務／義務服務／為社群服務」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 community service 在自願幫助社群的語境中非常接近。
words.example: Students are encouraged to take part in voluntary service during the summer.
words.exampleZh: 學校鼓勵學生在暑假參與志願服務。

exercises.original: Students are encouraged to complete community service during the summer, but participation is not compulsory.
exercises.zh: 學校鼓勵學生暑假參與社區服務，但並非強制。
exercises.upgrade: Students are encouraged to take part in voluntary service during the summer.

options.explanation: not compulsory 明確表示服務是自願的。
法院命令正是強制性，和句意相反。
是公共部門工作，通常是受薪職位。
是專業領域，不等於一般學生志願服務。
requirement 表示必須做，和 not compulsory 衝突。
可指「義工」這個人，詞性和結構不合。

exercises.original: She spent six months doing community service by helping at a local shelter entirely by choice.
exercises.zh: 她完全出於自願，在本地收容所做了六個月社區服務。
exercises.upgrade: She spent six months doing voluntary service at a local shelter.

options.explanation: entirely by choice 是最直接線索。
不是自然固定表達，而且 punishment 與自願相反。
專業社工工作通常需要專業身份。
名詞「自願性」，不是服務活動。

exercises.original: The award honours young people who show long-term commitment to community service.
exercises.zh: 這個獎項表揚長期投入志願社區服務的年輕人。
exercises.upgrade: The award honours young people who show long-term commitment to voluntary service.

options.explanation: 獎項＋長期自願服務最自然。
過廣，可包括參加會議等非服務活動。
加入 paid 後失去 voluntary service 的核心。

words.note: 表示由義工提供的服務。
words.example: The centre depends heavily on volunteer service.
words.exampleZh: 中心非常依賴義工服務。

exercises.original: The food bank depends heavily on community service provided by unpaid helpers.
exercises.zh: 食物銀行非常依賴無薪義工提供的社區服務。
exercises.upgrade: The food bank depends heavily on volunteer service.

options.explanation: provided by unpaid helpers 直接指出由義工提供。
通常指公共機構服務，範圍不同。
太廣，不一定包括實際服務工作。
形容詞，不能單獨代替名詞片語。

exercises.original: The hospital recognized thousands of hours of community service contributed by volunteers.
exercises.zh: 醫院表揚義工貢獻的數千小時服務。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital recognized thousands of hours of volunteer service.

options.explanation: hours + contributed by volunteers 是自然搭配。
可包括很多非服務活動。
主要指捐款／捐物，不是服務時數。

exercises.original: The museum could not operate its weekend programme without community service from local volunteers.
exercises.zh: 若沒有本地義工的服務，博物館無法運作週末計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The museum could not operate its weekend programme without volunteer service.

options.explanation: 重點是 volunteers 實際提供工作。
太廣，未必涉及實際輪班工作。
表示志願服務的理念／制度，而不是具體服務時數。

words.note: 非常常見、自然，表示無薪、自願幫助他人或機構的工作。
words.example: She does volunteer work at a local food bank.
words.exampleZh: 她在本地食物銀行做義工。

exercises.original: She does community service at a local food bank every Saturday.
exercises.zh: 她每星期六在本地食物銀行做義工。
exercises.upgrade: She does volunteer work at a local food bank every Saturday.

options.explanation: 日常英文中非常自然地表示無薪義工工作。
是專業領域，不等於食物銀行一般義工。
太廣，可能只是參與社區討論。
意思也很接近，但若保留 does ___，does volunteering 不如 does volunteer work 自然。

exercises.original: His application includes 200 hours of community service with children.
exercises.zh: 他的申請資料包括二百小時為兒童服務的義工工作。
exercises.upgrade: His application includes 200 hours of volunteer work with children.

options.explanation: 200 hours 是典型履歷／申請中的義工時數。
金錢或物資捐贈不能用工作時數衡量成同一概念。
投票是公民參與，但不是義工工作。

exercises.original: The company gives employees paid leave to do community service.
exercises.zh: 公司給員工有薪假期去做義工服務。
exercises.upgrade: The company gives employees paid leave to do volunteer work.

options.explanation: 員工用特別假期去做義工，是常見 corporate volunteering 語境。
可屬 civic engagement，但不一定是 service。
動詞過去式，不能接在 do 後。

words.note: 和 volunteer work 非常接近。
words.example: He has done voluntary work with older people for several years.
words.exampleZh: 他多年來一直為長者提供志願服務。

exercises.original: He has done community service with older people for several years.
exercises.zh: 他多年來一直為長者做志願工作。
exercises.upgrade: He has done voluntary work with older people for several years.

options.explanation: 表示社工專業，未必無薪。
voluntarily 是副詞；此處需要名詞片語。

exercises.original: The school encourages pupils to gain experience through community service.
exercises.zh: 學校鼓勵學生透過志願工作累積經驗。
exercises.upgrade: The school encourages pupils to gain experience through voluntary work.

options.explanation: 學校鼓勵但非強制的服務活動很自然。
強制性和 voluntary 相反。
社區諮詢不等於服務工作。
可以指人或動詞，不是這裡需要的名詞片語。

exercises.original: Her CV lists community service at a refugee support centre.
exercises.zh: 她的履歷列出在難民支援中心做的志願工作。
exercises.upgrade: Her CV lists voluntary work at a refugee support centre.

words.meaning: 社區義工服務；社區志願工作
words.note: 直接強調 volunteering 發生在社區層面。
words.example: The programme encourages community volunteering among teenagers.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃鼓勵青少年參與社區義工服務。

exercises.original: The programme encourages community service among teenagers in the neighbourhood.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃鼓勵區內青少年參與社區義工服務。
exercises.upgrade: The programme encourages community volunteering among teenagers.

options.explanation: 既保留 volunteering，也明確限定 community。
公民參與的一種，但不是義工服務。
捐贈，不是投入時間服務。

exercises.original: Community service can help residents get to know one another.
exercises.zh: 社區義工服務可以幫助居民互相認識。
exercises.upgrade: Community volunteering can help residents get to know one another.

options.explanation: 居民一起做義工，最貼近原意。
也可促進聯繫，但範圍更廣，不一定是服務。
詞序不同，通常表示「一個做義工的社群」，不是活動本身。

exercises.original: The city created an online portal for people looking for community service opportunities.
exercises.zh: 城市建立網上平台，方便市民尋找社區義工機會。
exercises.upgrade: The city created an online portal for community volunteering opportunities.

options.explanation: opportunities + residents serving locally 很自然。
可能包含諮詢、會議等，不一定是 volunteering opportunities。
是理念／制度，不自然接 opportunities。

words.meaning: 本地義工服務；地區志願工作
words.note: 指在自己所在地區或社區參與義工活動。
words.example: Local volunteering can help residents build stronger connections.
words.exampleZh: 本地義工服務可以幫助居民建立更緊密的聯繫。

exercises.original: Community service close to home can strengthen neighbourhood ties.
exercises.zh: 在本地做義工可以加強鄰里聯繫。
exercises.upgrade: Local volunteering can strengthen neighbourhood ties.

options.explanation: close to home 直接指本地義工服務。

exercises.original: She prefers community service in her own neighbourhood rather than volunteering overseas.
exercises.zh: 她較喜歡在自己社區做本地義工，而不是到海外服務。
exercises.upgrade: She prefers local volunteering to volunteering overseas.

options.explanation: 直接和 overseas volunteering 對比。

exercises.original: The website lists community service opportunities within five kilometres of your home.
exercises.zh: 網站列出距離你住所五公里內的本地義工機會。
exercises.upgrade: The website lists local volunteering opportunities.

options.explanation: 距離住所很近，重點就是 local。
可以很接近，但沒有地理鄰近這個重點。

words.note: 表示公民為社會、社區或公共利益提供服務。
words.example: The programme promotes civic service among young adults.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃鼓勵年輕成年人參與公民服務。

exercises.original: The programme promotes community service as part of young people's responsibilities as citizens.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃把社區服務視為年輕人的公民責任之一。
exercises.upgrade: The programme promotes civic service among young people.

options.explanation: responsibilities as citizens 明確帶公民服務意味。
公職不等於自願公民服務。
形容詞，不能單獨取代名詞片語。

exercises.original: Schools can encourage community service to develop a sense of citizenship.
exercises.zh: 學校可透過公民服務培養學生的公民意識。
exercises.upgrade: Schools can encourage civic service to develop a sense of citizenship.

options.explanation: 也接近，但沒有 civic responsibility 的明確焦點。
更廣，可包括投票、參與諮詢。
不是這裡所需活動名詞。

exercises.original: The award recognizes outstanding community service by young citizens.
exercises.zh: 這個獎項表揚年輕公民傑出的公民服務。
exercises.upgrade: The award recognizes outstanding civic service by young citizens.

options.explanation: 是公民身份／公民資格，不是服務。

words.note: 非常直接的描述性改寫。
words.example: The award recognizes outstanding service to the community.
words.exampleZh: 這個獎項表揚傑出的社區服務。

exercises.original: The award honours her many years of community service.
exercises.zh: 這個獎項表揚她多年為社區服務。
exercises.upgrade: The award honours her many years of service to the community.

options.explanation: 正式、直接，而且很適合 awards 語境。
不一定服務本地社區，也通常是受薪。
缺少冠詞／介詞，並非自然名詞片語。

exercises.original: Her record of community service includes mentoring, food distribution, and park clean-ups.
exercises.zh: 她的社區服務紀錄包括師友輔導、派發食物和清潔公園。
exercises.upgrade: Her record of service to the community includes mentoring, food distribution, and park clean-ups.

options.explanation: 涵蓋不同形式服務，範圍自然。
原句包含大量實際行動，不只是捐款。
三種活動不全屬專業社工工作。

exercises.original: The scholarship considers applicants' academic results and community service.
exercises.zh: 獎學金會考慮申請人的學業成績及社區服務表現。
exercises.upgrade: The scholarship considers applicants' academic results and service to the community.

words.note: 強調幫助別人，而不一定只限某個地理社區。
words.example: The school encourages students to develop a commitment to service to others.
words.exampleZh: 學校鼓勵學生培養服務他人的精神。

exercises.original: The school teaches that community service should help students develop concern for other people.
exercises.zh: 學校認為社區服務應培養學生關懷他人、服務他人的精神。
exercises.upgrade: The school encourages a commitment to service to others.

options.explanation: 教育價值語境中自然，強調 helping people。
屬公民參與，但不是直接助人服務。
service 作動詞在這裡語感不同，通常不用來泛指慈善助人。

exercises.original: Her life has been shaped by a strong commitment to community service and helping vulnerable people.
exercises.zh: 她的人生深受服務他人、幫助弱勢人士的信念影響。
exercises.upgrade: Her life has been shaped by a strong commitment to service to others.

options.explanation: helping vulnerable people 直接支持此表達。
不一定涉及 vulnerable people，也不一定無薪。
缺少正確結構；一般會說 serve others 或 service to others。

exercises.original: The programme treats community service as part of an ethic of helping people beyond oneself.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃把社區服務視為超越個人、服務他人的一種價值。
exercises.upgrade: The programme treats service to others as an important value.

options.explanation: 強調道德／價值上的助人。
單獨作名詞太模糊，且失去 others 對象。

words.note: 在很多語境中可表示為社區進行的工作或服務。
words.example: She has spent years doing community work in disadvantaged neighbourhoods.
words.exampleZh: 她多年來一直在弱勢社區從事社區工作。

exercises.original: She has spent years doing community service in disadvantaged neighbourhoods.
exercises.zh: 她多年來一直在弱勢地區從事社區工作。
exercises.upgrade: She has spent years doing community work in disadvantaged neighbourhoods.

options.explanation: 自然、廣泛，可涵蓋不同社區服務活動。
更專業，通常指受訓社工的工作。
通常表示共同勞動，不一定是服務社區。

exercises.original: His community service involves organizing youth activities and supporting local families.
exercises.zh: 他的社區工作包括組織青年活動和支援本地家庭。
exercises.upgrade: His community work involves organizing youth activities and supporting local families.

options.explanation: 多種社區活動的自然總稱。
太廣，可能只是出席會議。
不一定有專業社工資格。

exercises.original: The organization thanked her for decades of community service.
exercises.zh: 機構感謝她數十年的社區工作。
exercises.upgrade: The organization thanked her for decades of community work.

options.explanation: 長期服務社區的中性說法。
較抽象，未必是實際服務。
共同勞動，不一定公益服務。

words.note: 表示參與公共、社區或公民生活。
words.example: Volunteering is one form of civic engagement.
words.exampleZh: 義工服務是公民參與的一種形式。

exercises.original: Community service is one way young people can participate actively in public life.
exercises.zh: 社區服務是年輕人積極參與公共生活的一種方式。
exercises.upgrade: Community service is one form of civic engagement.

options.explanation: community service 是 civic engagement 的其中一種形式。
不是所有公共參與都是工作。
法律處分，並非此句的廣義公民參與重點。

exercises.original: The course links community service, voting, and participation in local meetings.
exercises.zh: 課程把社區服務、投票和參加地方會議都視為公民參與。
exercises.upgrade: The course treats these activities as forms of civic engagement.

options.explanation: 不能涵蓋所有列舉活動。

exercises.original: The report describes community service as part of wider citizen participation.
exercises.zh: 報告把社區服務視為更廣泛公民參與的一部分。
exercises.upgrade: The report describes community service as part of wider civic engagement.

options.explanation: 原句已明說 wider citizen participation。
和 community service 更接近，但不是「更大的上位概念」。

words.meaning: 法院命令的社區服務；社會服務令工作
words.note: 當 community service 指司法判決要求完成的無薪工作時，這個描述性說法更精確。
words.example: He was required to complete 100 hours of court-ordered community work.
words.exampleZh: 他被要求完成一百小時法院命令的社區服務。

exercises.original: The judge sentenced him to 100 hours of community service.
exercises.zh: 法官判他完成一百小時社區服務令。
exercises.upgrade: The judge sentenced him to 100 hours of court-ordered community work.

options.explanation: judge sentenced 明確表示這是刑罰的一部分。
自願服務，和 sentence 的強制性不合。
公民參與，不是法律刑罰。

exercises.original: Instead of a short prison sentence, she was required to complete community service.
exercises.zh: 她沒有被判短期監禁，而是被要求完成法院命令的社區工作。
exercises.upgrade: She was required to complete court-ordered community work.

options.explanation: instead of prison + required 是法律語境強線索。

exercises.original: He completed his community service sentence by cleaning public spaces.
exercises.zh: 他透過清潔公共空間完成法院判處的社區服務令。
exercises.upgrade: He completed his court-ordered community work by cleaning public spaces.

options.explanation: 活動形式可能相似，但缺少法院強制性。

falseSynonyms.zh: 慈善工作 ≠ 所有社區服務 charity work 通常為慈善機構或慈善目的服務。 community service 可以在學校、社區中心、環保活動等更廣環境中進行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Helping at a charity shop is charity work. Cleaning a local park can be community service without involving a charity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 公共服務 ≠ 一般義工服務 public service 常指政府／公共機構提供的服務，也可指公職。 它比 community service 更制度化。
社會工作 ≠ 社區服務 social work 是一個專業領域，通常由受訓 social workers 從事。
捐款 ≠ 提供服務 捐錢可以支持社區，但 community service 通常涉及實際投入時間或勞動。
社區參與 ≠ 一定做服務 參加居民會議或諮詢活動也是 community engagement，但未必是 community service。
高度相關，但不一定完全相同 volunteering 可以發生在海外、網上、私人機構等，不一定以本地社區為對象。
詞性陷阱 - volunteer = 義工；自願做 - voluntary = 自願的 - volunteering = 做義工／義工活動
法律語境與自願語境不能混淆 第一句可能是自願服務；第二句是刑罰的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: She chose to do community service. He was sentenced to community service.
